meta.name: exploratory-data-analysis
meta.description: Perform comprehensive exploratory data analysis on scientific data files across 200+ file formats. This skill should be used when analyzing any scientific data file to understand its structure, content, quality, and characteristics. Automatically detects file type and generates detailed markdown reports with format-specific analysis, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations. Covers chemistry, bioinformatics, microscopy, spectroscopy, proteomics, metabolomics, and general scientific data formats.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析科学数据文件并生成详细报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解科学数据文件的结构和质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically analyze scientific data files and generate detailed reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and quality of scientific data files

howto.what: 装上后，当你提供科学数据文件路径，Claude 会自动检测文件类型，进行格式特定的分析，并生成一份详细的 Markdown 报告，包含数据结构、质量评估和后续分析建议。
howto.when: 当你提供科学数据文件路径，或要求“探索”、“分析”、“总结”一个数据文件时触发。

say.text: 分析这个 FASTQ 文件，告诉我序列质量和 GC 含量。
say.note: Claude 会检测文件类型，进行序列分析并生成报告。

say.text: 探索 experiment_results.csv 的结构和缺失值。
帮我看看 cells.nd2 显微镜图像的维度和通道信息。

howto.what_en: When you provide a path to a scientific data file, Claude automatically detects the file type, performs format-specific analysis, and generates a detailed Markdown report covering data structure, quality metrics, and downstream analysis recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a scientific data file path or ask to 'explore', 'analyze', or 'summarize' a data file.

say_en.text: Analyze this FASTQ file and tell me about sequence quality and GC content.
Explore experiment_results.csv for structure and missing values.
say_en.note: Claude loads the CSV, analyzes dimensions, data types, missing values, etc.

say_en.text: Check the dimensions and channel info of cells.nd2 microscopy image.
say_en.note: Claude reads the ND2 file, extracts image dimensions, channels, metadata.
